description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 437 (MP(I)-11). PART (participation) is the subject; HI-P (high purpose) is the partner. From the subject: UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)), IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) and CULT-O (culture order). From UNF-PI: TR (transformation). From IF-ST-DY: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From CULT-O: RIT-DY (ritual dynamics). From TR: OBS (observation). From AF-DY: MT-INFO (multi-information). From RIT-DY: MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance). From MTA-RT-SIGN: P-FC (particular focus).
